scene: Day 190, grey morning at the depot gate. Patch (white round head, orange bandage above his right eye, orange backpack) clings to the top of the aluminium canopy ladder beside the wide-open sliding gate, close to the camera, eyes huge, one sweat drop, a rope wrapped around his fist. Just below his shoes, the beige coach noses out through the gateway, its headlights on, while green walkers walk backward in front of it with their palms flat on the windshield, and behind the glass the woman (round white head, brown driving goggles pulled down over her eyes, long grey scarf) grips the big steering wheel. Hundreds more walkers pour through the gate around the coach. Tense because the whole horde is passing an arm's length under him.

Day 185, frozen white dawn in the packed depot yard. The folding door of the beige coach stands open, and the night driver walker (green head, navy-blue two-pocket vest) steps slowly down the coach steps into a frost-covered crowd of green walkers, his face turned up. Above him, Nora (purple band on her forearm) leans over the front edge of the canopy roof, one hand reaching out. In the foreground, Patch lies flat on the frosty coach roof holding a long pole with a wire hook, looking back at the camera with wide frightened eyes. Tense because the last passenger is leaving and the whole frozen crowd is starting to look up.
